scope: Current task-level factual package for the Fremennik Achievement Diary. It proposes future normalized actions and graph structure only. It does not edit production data, duplicate established Fremennik quest, Miscellania, balloon, eagle, Trollheim, or transport facts, assign strategy scores, or generate a route.

included: quest, minigame, location, encounter, and skill gates

source_catalog.use: Authoritative current task list, stated boostability, current tier rewards, and diary-specific change history.
Universal tier-claim rule, task-order rule, and current summary requirement conventions.
Cross-check for individual task skills, tools, explicitly non-boostable requirements, and location alternatives.
Hard-task potion inputs, exact 150 Herblore XP, and province-location exclusion.
Medium Lighthouse and elite Dagannoth King traversal gates and two-person-door alternatives.
Elite multi-boss task identity and noted-bone reward applicability.
Elite general and Spiritual mage locations, entrance alternatives, and encounter boundaries.
Waterbirth Teleport, Tan Leather, Recharge Dragonstone, Lunar Isle interaction, and return-orb reward effects.
Medium, hard, and elite approval-rate reward wording and 100-percent-support task context.
Diary-gated destination expansion, Fossegrimen sacrifice thresholds, and charge behavior.
Official historical confirmation of the Fremennik reward design, including lyre destinations, Troll Stronghold rooftop access, Lunar spells, and noted Dagannoth bones.
Official confirmation of the Sea Boots teleport-quantity adjustment history.
Official confirmation of the current lower-tier Sea Boots daily-teleport adjustment.

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: A tier claim requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a task skill requirement unless the task explicitly says not boostable.
global_rules.proposed_task_transition: Each successful task action adds only its fremennik_diary_<tier>_<task> milestone. It does not infer variable loot, combat success, animal catches, minigame outcomes, kingdom approval, or daily counters.

existing_normalization_reference.boundary: This package references existing Fremennik Trials, Isles, Lunar, Trollheim, kingdom, eagle, balloon, and transport facts by capability or quest milestone. It does not restate their production actions or graph edges.

unresolved_conflicts.detail: Rock crabs, brine rat, thefts, catches, Waterbirth traversal, Dagannoth Kings, God Wars generals, and Spiritual mage tasks need player-confirmed success. The diary package does not assert combat readiness, kill rate, supplies, door traversal, or loot.
The 100% support task and the medium/elite approval bonuses reference existing Managing Miscellania facts. Approval gain, decay, work choice, and collection are not simulated here.
Sea Boots teleports and repeat service effects are capabilities. The account schema does not yet advance a calendar day or consume a daily-use counter.
Several tasks share the dungeon's two-person doors. The package records helper, pet-rock plus rune-thrownaxe, and 85-Agility alternatives without choosing one or declaring it universally required.

Current Wiki wording identifies 920 completion XP and improved mark behavior after hard completion; the exact stochastic mark-rate model belongs in a dedicated Agility/recurrence fact, not this diary package.
The package deliberately references, rather than duplicates, existing Fremennik quest, Miscellania, balloon/eagle, Trollheim, and transport fact records.
